plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin DE from Salmon quant + fgsea
plan.analytical_narrative: The delivered inputs are per-sample Salmon quant.sf files (30,147 transcripts) plus a transcript-to-gene map, not a gene-level count matrix — so the pipeline must start with tximport to build gene-level counts with the average transcript-length offset before any count model can run. The design is a clean, unpaired two-group comparison (6 AD lesional skin vs 6 control skin, single batch, no known covariates), which supports a standard DESeq2 Wald-test workflow per the retrieved procedure. Steps proceed: (1) tximport gene-level import from the quant.sf directories using the supplied tx2gene.csv, (2) sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) to check the AD-lesional/control samples cluster as expected and to catch any lesion/control identity or outlier problem before testing, (3) minimal low-count pre-filter, (4) DESeq2 Wald test with condition releveled so Control is the reference (contrast: condition AD_lesional vs Control), (5) apeglm shrinkage of the reported log2 fold change, (6) BH multiple-testing correction with DESeq2's independent filtering at alpha 0.05, (7) gene identifier annotation (Ensembl/Entrez/symbol) via org.Hs.eg.db, (8) a DE report with QC/MA/dispersion diagnostics and a full reproducibility record, and (9) fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome, and WikiPathways-human gene sets (all present in the reference store) to place the DE genes in pathway context. Tissue-identity and gene-tissue-expression context checks use the Human Protein Atlas and GTEx v8 skin reference already staged. All packages (tximport, DESeq2, apeglm, org.Hs.eg.db, AnnotationDbi, fgsea) and reference gene sets are confirmed present in this environment.

flags.message: If fewer than about 50 genes pass the significance threshold, do not run an over-representation test on that list. A hypergeometric test of a short list finds no category, and a change of the threshold changes the list and the result. Run the ranked method on the full list of tested genes instead, because it finds a set of genes with a small but coordinated change that no single gene shows. State the size of the significant list in the report.
